name: Cafè Jochum
kurzbeschreibung:
**Cafè Jochum in Riezlern**

Welcome to **Cafè Jochum** in the heart of **Riezlern**, a charming village nestled in the **Tirol** Alps. Here, you’ll find a cozy retreat where tradition meets modern comfort.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**, served with a side of fresh apple compote—just like your grandma used to make. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Melange** or a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein**.

Our terrace offers breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains, perfect for relaxing after a day of hiking or skiing. Whether you’re here for a quick coffee break or a leisurely brunch, **Cafè Jochum** promises an unforgettable experience in the heart of **Tirol**.
